x-dhbw-bloom_taxonomy.note: Four-level condensed scale. Levels 5+6 of original Bloom merged into L4.

1.description: Recall facts, name concepts, demonstrate foundational knowledge.

2.description: Explain ideas or apply knowledge to routine problems.

3.description: Draw connections, deconstruct, differentiate, determine relationships.

4.description: Justify decisions, design novel solutions, critique, judge, generate original work.

entwickeln.hint: Routine output -> L2; analytical -> L3; novel/independent creation -> L4

begründen.hint: Simple reasons -> L2; complex critical argumentation -> L3

entwerfen.hint: Routine design -> L2; complex architectural design -> L4

bewerten.hint: Analytical assessment of known criteria -> L3; evaluative judgement with competing options -> L4

einarbeiten.hint: Guided introduction -> L2; independent deep specialisation -> L3

auseinandersetzen.hint: Passive engagement -> L2; critical examination of multiple perspectives -> L3
